nome_jp: 沸天混成 ジョバンセン・ガロウズ
testo:
EX Life
Triple Breaker Power Attacker
■ When you put this creature, return all spells from your graveyard to your hand.
■ Whenever you tap cards in your mana zone to cast a spell, you may change the mana numbers of any number of those cards to 2.
